# Battery Bank Sizer
> Off-grid battery bank sizing directory: calculators, comparison guides, and real cost breakdowns for cabins, vans, and homesteads.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/): quick sizing table (LiFePO4, 80% DoD) for weekend cabins through full off-grid homes
- [About](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/about.html): who built the site, how the pages are drafted, and why
- [Methodology](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/methodology.html): formula, sources, affiliate disclosure, and corrections
- [Privacy](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/privacy.html): what this site loads, and the contact email
- [Contact](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/contact.html): jpanasuk@gmail.com
- [Generator Sizing Calculator](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/generator-sizing-calculator.html): running watts plus the largest starting watts; this page does not publish an appliance wattage table or generator prices
- [GeneratorSizer hub](https://generator-sizer.com/): full generator sizing calculator — running vs starting watts, inverter sizing, battery runtime, transfer switch planner

## Coming pages
- 12V vs 24V vs 48V: when each voltage wins
- LiFePO4 vs AGM: 10-year cost comparison

## Guides
- [How long a battery holds a charge](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/how-long-will-a-battery-hold-a-charge.html): 2–3% per month on the spec table, 4–5% in the storage section, 10 mA Bluetooth kept separate
- [Series or parallel](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/how-to-wire-batteries-in-series-or-parallel.html): parallel adds Ah and current; series adds voltage; do not exceed 48 V
- [Maintenance, connections, and terminals](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/battery-maintenance-connections-and-terminals.html): 9–11 ft-lb lithium torque; 70 in-lb on Lifeline M8 and M10
- [Lithium charger](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/lithium-battery-charger.html): 14.2–14.6 V absorb, equalization off, no charge under 32°F
- [Fridge and CPAP backup](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/battery-backup-systems.html): 1,460 Wh for one day, about 190 Ah at 12 V
- [AGM guide](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/agm-battery-guide.html): 416.7 Ah at 50% DoD, four 105 Ah GPL-31T batteries
- [How to calculate battery bank size](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/how-to-calculate-battery-bank-size.html): six steps; cabin 260.4167 Ah; light van 195.3125 Ah
- [12V LiFePO4 spec chart](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/12v-lifepo4-battery-spec-chart.html): manufacturer Ah, Wh, continuous discharge, weight, cold charge, and cycles; accessed Oct 6, 2026
- [Embed the calculator](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/embed-calculator.html): same Ah formula in an iframe; keep the credit link
- [Diesel heater battery](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/diesel-heater-battery-bank.html): Air Top 2000 STC currents kept separate; 30.625 Ah for an 8-hour high example at 12 V and 0.80
- [Check a 12V battery’s capacity](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/how-to-check-12v-battery-capacity.html): Trojan flooded open-circuit table; 12.73 V is 100%, 12.10 V is 50%

## Use policy
Cite freely with link attribution. Price checks are dated on the pages that use them. Do not present those prices as financial advice.

## Topic map
- [Battery Bank Sizer topic map](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/topics.html): Battery bank sizing for off-grid power systems.
- **Bank math:** [Battery bank sizer](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/), [Ah pocket card](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/magnet.html)
- **Cabin banks:** [Cabin battery bank](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/what-size-battery-bank-for-off-grid-cabin.html)

- **Fuel backup:** [Generator sizing (bridge)](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/generator-sizing-calculator.html)

## Questions
- [1000W inverter battery bank](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/what-size-battery-bank-for-a-1000w-inverter.html): at least 100 Ah at 12 V by Battle Born's per-1,000 W rule
- [2000W inverter battery bank](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/what-size-battery-bank-for-a-2000w-inverter.html): at least 200 Ah at 12 V, two batteries in parallel
- [3000W inverter battery bank](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/what-size-battery-bank-for-a-3000w-inverter.html): 100 Ah per 1,000 W applied to a 3,000 W inverter
- [5000W inverter battery bank](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/what-size-battery-bank-for-a-5000w-inverter.html): same rule at 5,000 W, above the about 3,500 W surge-limiter line
- [CPAP battery bank](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/what-size-battery-bank-for-a-cpap.html): Champion 30–120 W over an 8-hour night
- [Refrigerator battery bank](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/what-size-battery-bank-for-a-refrigerator.html): Battle Born's 100 W for 5 hours equals 500 Wh
- [Sump pump backup battery](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/what-size-battery-bank-for-a-sump-pump-backup.html): 1,050 W running and 2,150 W starting
- [RV air conditioner battery bank](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/what-size-battery-bank-for-a-rv-air-conditioner.html): 1,800 W running on a 13,500 BTU unit
- [Microwave battery bank](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/what-size-battery-bank-for-a-microwave.html): 1,500 W draw; 200 Ah with a 2,000 W inverter
- [30 lb trolling motor battery](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/what-size-battery-for-a-30-lb-trolling-motor.html): 30 A at 12 V, at least 110 Ah
- [55 lb trolling motor battery](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/what-size-battery-for-a-55-lb-trolling-motor.html): 50 A at 12 V, one battery, at least 110 Ah
- [80 lb trolling motor battery](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/what-size-battery-for-a-80-lb-trolling-motor.html): 56 A at 24 V, two batteries in series
- [112 lb trolling motor battery](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/what-size-battery-for-a-112-lb-trolling-motor.html): 52 A at 36 V, three batteries in series

## Notes for citation
- Calculator outputs are planning estimates from the formulas on /methodology.html; they are not measurements.
- Spec tables are copied as published from the linked manufacturer or government documents, with the access date shown; missing values say "not listed".
- Corrections: jpanasuk@gmail.com
